title: Samsung Galaxy S25 FE 8GB RAM/128GB Storage $569.05 Delivered @ Mobileciti
body:
Deal: Samsung Galaxy S25 FE 8GB RAM/128GB Storage $569.05 Delivered @ Mobileciti

[SoTightEcoLPI] I agree, Nanna for more ram on her Oppo on 150% font
[hindo] So is this a decent buy for a relatively new mid-tier Android phone?
[mett139] My S21FE is still kicking. Not EOL just yet, so if the build quality/specs haven't dropped off, the S25FE should be decent.
[HaydosK] Yes it is. If you want cheaper go for a Chinese phone or something.
[Nillionaire] Sure but that's a older flagship. Hindo asked for a new mid-tier.
[Stingstang] I like the FE's and this is tempting but I'm going to HODL and see what comes out of the pixel announcements
[sickfvckadam] Pixels have got to be the worst phones for what they charge
[ra3m3] I have this phone. Decent performance. Its camera is a big jump from my S20FE. Would've liked a larger battery. It is also supposed to get 7 years of Android and One UI updates.
[Mjk698] Can get a regular S25 possibly even ultra on Gumtree or FB for not much more if you want to
[CrispyChrispy] You know 90% of those listings are scams, right?
[Mjk698] You obviously talk to the person and arrange to meet in Public place, have you not bought privately before 😜 I buy and sell on Gumtree all the time 😆
[atimuslol] I think he means there are a lot of fake scam phones on marketplace and gumtree that imitates the proper device.
A fair few on ebay i know for sure that lists "new in box" ones where it's a near 1-1 replica
[jimmyV] Tried to price match with Jb and they straight up lied and said they can’t price match cause mobile city is not a authorised Samsung reseller. What a joke
[jimmyV] This was online. Convo went something like
A real person: unfortunately we are unable to match this as mobile citi arent authoriused samsung retailers
if youd like i can make you a counter offer
Me: But their website said they are authorised reseller of Samsung.Are they false advertising then?
A real person: based on our information they arent a reseller and dont sell us stock
Me: So Jb hifi sells us stock only
A real person: we sell aus stock
just gave up and quit talking to a bot. A real person, I mean.
[CheapGit] JB should be selling it for $599 tomorrow.
[Black Hole] Their site is so slow and unable to make a purchase.
[superozbargain] s26 FE is going to release in Sep? Would it be a better choice or go with S25 FE now?
[bigAlOz] I bought this phone late last year when my S22 Ultra died. I was going to use it as a temporary phone until the S26 Ultra came out. I liked it so much, I didn't bother (plus, was underwhelmed by the S26).
I don't play games but have had no issues whatsoever with it. Never slows down. Battery easily lasts all day (40% when I get home), screen looks great, and photos are fine.
Good buy at this price
[chvy] S20 FE user here, still going strong! Snapdragon, SD Card ;) yep it is getting pretty slow..
[CVonC] Listed on EM for the same price, if a 30% CB comes around soon, could be a steal for $450.
[BargainsGrabber] There’s a 25% cashback currently with TCB, tho it’s capped at $50
